definitions.explanation: The act of putting money into financial schemes, property, or business ventures with the expectation of profit.
Devoting resources like time or effort to something with expectation of future benefit.

notes:
{投資|とうし} is a compound: ⟦{投|とう}→投：noentry⟧ (throw/put in) + ⟦{資|し}→資：noentry⟧ (capital).

TYPES OF {投資|とうし}:
- ⟦{株式|かぶしき}→株式：04772_kabushiki⟧{投資|とうし} (stock investment)
- ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧{投資|とうし} (real estate investment)
- ⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧{投資|とうし} (capital investment)
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{投資|とうし} (overseas investment)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投資|とうし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to invest)
- {投資|とうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to make an investment)
- ⟦{投資家|とうしか}→投資家：16242_toushika⟧ (investor)
- {投資|とうし}⟦{信託|しんたく}→信託：noentry⟧ (investment trust/mutual fund)
- {投資|とうし}⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧ (investment target)
